international.title: Trump alleges ‘fake’ economic figures released before US midterms but doesn’t provide evidence
international.summary: In a Thanksgiving post, the US president seeks investigation after blue wave of Democrats unseat Republicans Donald Trump has alleged without evidence that economic figures published by the US federal government before this month’s midterm elections were “fake” and demanded an investigation after voters roundly rejected his Republican party. In a holiday message on social media tinged with bitterness, the US president wished a happy thanksgiving “to even those who issued fake Economic Numbers, just prior to the Election, and corrected them yesterday, three weeks late, showing that the GDP was actually 4.3%, versus 3.4%”.
